bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; prohibiting the commissioner of public safety from determining insurance requirements for towing vehicles; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 168B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[168B.041] INSURANCE REQUIREMENTS FOR TOWING VEHICLES. +]

[+(a) For purposes of this section, "on-hook towing insurance" means liability insurance for a vehicle or other conveyance while attached or connected to a tow truck. +]

[+(b) The commissioner of public safety or the Minnesota State Patrol must not adopt any rule, regulation, order, or procedure that requires a towing service to carry a set amount of on-hook towing insurance for towed vehicles valued at less than $400,000. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively from August 1, 2023, and applies to orders issued on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; prohibiting the commissioner of public safety from determining insurance requirements for towing vehicles; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 168B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[168B.041] INSURANCE REQUIREMENTS FOR TOWING VEHICLES.

(a) For purposes of this section, "on-hook towing insurance" means liability insurance for a vehicle or other conveyance while attached or connected to a tow truck.

(b) The commissioner of public safety or the Minnesota State Patrol must not adopt any rule, regulation, order, or procedure that requires a towing service to carry a set amount of on-hook towing insurance for towed vehicles valued at less than $400,000.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively from August 1, 2023, and applies to orders issued on or after that date.
additions: (a) For purposes of this section, "on-hook towing insurance" means liability insurance for a vehicle or other conveyance while attached or connected to a tow truck.

(b) The commissioner of public safety or the Minnesota State Patrol must not adopt any rule, regulation, order, or procedure that requires a towing service to carry a set amount of on-hook towing insurance for towed vehicles valued at less than $400,000.
This section is effective retroactively from August 1, 2023, and applies to orders issued on or after that date.
